Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Ni in octahedral O coordination and Li in octahedral O coordination, while V adopts tetrahedral O coordination; these polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between Li and V, and edge-sharing between Li and Ni octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
